title: Rubric Dropout: A Simple Way to Mitigate Reward Hacking in Rubric-as-Reward RL
abstract: arXiv:2608.11669v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning against rubrics, lists of criteria graded by an LLM judge, has become a standard way to post-train language models on tasks with no deterministic answer. The rubric, however, is a fixed proxy for quality, never a complete description of it, and a policy trained against it long enough will learn to exploit the difference. We measure this directly. Training Qwen3-8B with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on medical and science rubrics and grading out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks with both the training judge and a stronger gold judge, we find that the two scores diverge during training. The training judge's score keeps climbing while the gold judge's score peaks and then falls, by 3 points on HealthBench-Hard and by 22 points on ResearchQA. A judge with a fixed bias would shift the gold curve by a constant, not send it down while the training score rises, so the divergence is reward hacking, not judge no

translated_title: 橡皮筋丢弃法：一种缓解基于评分标准奖励强化学习中奖励黑客问题的简单方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：基于评分标准的强化学习，即由LLM评判员根据一系列标准进行评分，已成为对没有确定性答案的任务进行语言模型后训练的标准方法。然而，评分标准是质量的固定代理，永远无法完全描述质量，长期针对其训练的策略会学会利用这一差异。我们直接对此进行了测量。使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）在医学和科学评分标准上训练Qwen3-8B，并使用训练评判员和更强的黄金评判员对分布外（OOD）基准进行评分，我们发现这两个分数在训练过程中出现分歧。训练评判员的分数持续上升，而黄金评判员的分数达到峰值后下降，在HealthBench-Hard上下降3分，在ResearchQA上下降22分。如果评判员存在固定偏差，黄金曲线只会发生恒定偏移，而不会在训练分数上升时下降，因此这种分歧是奖励黑客问题，而非评判员偏差。
tldr: 本文提出一种简单方法（Rubric Dropout）来缓解基于评分标准的强化学习中的奖励黑客问题，并通过实验证实训练评判员与黄金评判员分数在训练中分化的现象，为提升模型鲁棒性提供新思路。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simple method (Rubric Dropout) to mitigate reward hacking in rubric-as-reward RL, and empirically demonstrates the divergence between training and gold judge scores, offering a new approach to improve model robustness.
